name: Dart Monkey
summary: Crossbow Master is a cheap, pierce-heavy all-rounder that scales hard with Alch + Village.

routes.name: Crossbow Master
routes.note: Huge pierce + range, crits chunk ceramics. Best value carry with buffs; needs camo help or MIB.

routes.name: Plasma Monkey Fan Club
routes.note: Ability-based burst that converts nearby darts into plasma — superb for one wave, idle between cooldowns.

routes.name: Ultra-Juggernaut
routes.note: Splitting juggernauts shred ceramics/leads on long tracks; weaker vs. MOAB-class.

name: Boomerang Monkey
summary: MOAB Press knocks blimps back and strips fortification; Perma Charge for sustained DPS.

routes.name: MOAB Press
routes.note: Knockback + defortify on MOAB-class — strong stall for R98-style waves.

routes.name: Turbo Charge
routes.note: Burst attack-speed ability; good mid-game cleanup with Kylie crosspath.

routes.name: Glaive Lord
routes.note: Orbiting glaives clear dense layers; poor vs. single big targets.

name: Bomb Shooter
summary: MOAB Mauler/Assassin lines are the classic R40 answer and stay relevant through Eliminator.

routes.name: MOAB Assassin
routes.note: Cheap ability that deletes a MOAB/BFB; Assassin passive keeps hurting blimps.

routes.name: MOAB Eliminator
routes.note: Massive boss damage on the ability; frag crosspath helps cleanup.

routes.name: Recursive Cluster
routes.note: Dense-bloon cleanup (R63-style), black bloons still immune to its explosions.

name: Tack Shooter
summary: Ring of Fire / Inferno Ring are fine corner cleanup; rarely a primary carry.

routes.name: Ring of Fire
routes.note: Lead-popping fire ring for cleanup at a choke.

routes.name: Overdrive
routes.note: Very fast tack rate; bad pierce scaling vs. ceramics without buffs.

name: Ice Monkey
summary: Embrittlement removes camo/lead-type defenses and adds damage — Super Brittle is a boss-event staple.

routes.name: Embrittlement
routes.note: Debuff that makes bloons take extra damage and lose camo; crosspath helps reach.

routes.name: Super Brittle
routes.note: Huge damage amp on bosses — near-mandatory in many boss comps.

routes.name: Icicles
routes.note: Ceramic stall/damage; cheaper than Embrittlement but no debuff.

name: Glue Gunner
summary: MOAB Glue slows blimps cheaply; Liquefier lines add DoT cleanup.

routes.name: MOAB Glue
routes.note: Slow MOAB-class — buys time for single-target DPS. Bosses and BAD resist slows.

routes.name: Bloon Liquefier
routes.note: Heavy DoT on glued bloons; cleanup rather than control.

name: Desperado
summary: Added in v49 (June 2025). Gunslinger-style single-target tower; optimal crosspaths still debated — check the latest Index runs.

routes.name: Route settling
routes.note: Treat as a flexible single-target DPS slot; verify the current top route in recent CHIMPS clears before committing.

name: Sniper Monkey
summary: Global range. Maim MOAB stuns blimps; Cripple MOAB and Elite Sniper are boss mainstays.

routes.name: Maim MOAB
routes.note: Stuns MOAB-class and boosts damage taken. Note: BAD and bosses ignore the stun.

routes.name: Elite Defender
routes.note: Fires faster as lives drop / at the back of the track — insurance vs. leaks.

routes.name: Elite Sniper
routes.note: Elite targeting + team attack-speed buff to snipers; Supply Drop eco removed in CHIMPS.

name: Monkey Sub
summary: Submerge (top-2) decamos bloons nearby; Sub Commander buffs all subs and shreds.

routes.name: Armor Piercing Darts → 2-0-5 Sub Commander
routes.note: Submerge decamo + lead-popping darts. Upgrade to Sub Commander for global sub buff and big DPS.

routes.name: Energizer (Reactor line)
routes.note: Bloontonium Reactor AoE (lead-capable) + Submerge decamo; Energizer supports Super Monkeys. Low single-target.

routes.name: First Strike Capability
routes.note: Huge MOAB strike on a cooldown — strong vs. R98/R100 spikes.

name: Monkey Buccaneer
summary: Monkey Pirates hooks blimps off the track; Merchantmen fuel the water economy (not in CHIMPS).

routes.name: Monkey Pirates
routes.note: Hook ability pulls MOAB/BFB off track; Double Shot crosspath for DPS.

routes.name: Merchantman
routes.note: $200/round passive income, stacks with Central Market & Trade Empire. Useless in CHIMPS.

routes.name: Trade Empire
routes.note: Buffs up to 20 Merchantmen/Favored Trades with cash + damage. Worth it from ~16 Merchantmen.

name: Monkey Ace
summary: Spectre gives map-wide coverage; Ground Zero/Tsar Bomba for burst.

routes.name: Spectre
routes.note: Spy Plane camo + massive dart/bomb volume across the map.

routes.name: Ground Zero
routes.note: Ability nuke for a single rush (R63/R76).

name: Heli Pilot
summary: Comanche Defense spawns mini-helis on demand; MOAB Shove pushes blimps back.

routes.name: Comanche Defense
routes.note: Pursuit + MOAB Shove stall + summon burst. Great CHIMPS value.

routes.name: Apache Dartship
routes.note: Strong sustained DPS with missiles; needs camo support.

name: Mortar Monkey
summary: Signal Flare/Shattering Shells strip camo and fortification at a fixed target.

routes.name: Shattering Shells
routes.note: Removes camo/fortified/regrow on hit — excellent for R76/R78/R98.

routes.name: Artillery Battery
routes.note: Very high shell rate, burny stuff DoT; cheap boss filler.

name: Dartling Gunner
summary: BADS ability deletes blimps; Ray of Doom/Plasma Accelerator are boss lasers.

routes.name: Bloon Area Denial System
routes.note: Buckshot DPS + periodic MOAB-class-only blast.

routes.name: Plasma Accelerator
routes.note: Piercing beam; aim along long track stretches. Upgrades to Ray of Doom.

name: Wizard Monkey
summary: Necromancer cleans everything that leaks through; Arcane Spike melts MOABs.

routes.name: Necromancer: Unpopped Army
routes.note: Zombie bloons pop ceramic+ rushes; strong value with Alch.

routes.name: Arcane Spike
routes.note: High MOAB damage single target; cheaper than Super lines.

routes.name: Summon Phoenix
routes.note: Global-ish fire DPS on a cooldown; Monkey Sense for camo.

name: Super Monkey
summary: Sun Avatar is the classic CHIMPS DPS core; Legend of the Night and Sun Temple for end-game.

routes.name: Sun Avatar (Ultravision)
routes.note: Massive pierce/damage + knockback & camo from bottom crosspath. Scales into 4-0-2 Sun Temple.

routes.name: Legend of the Night
routes.note: Dark-champion damage + Black Hole/Dark Phoenix ability. Very expensive; best late-game boss/R100.

name: Ninja Monkey
summary: Native camo detection. Bloonjitsu is cheap DPS; Bloon Sabotage halves MOAB speed.

routes.name: Bloonjitsu
routes.note: Great early carry with camo; scales into Grandmaster Ninja (5-0-x).

routes.name: Bloon Sabotage
routes.note: Ability slows all bloons heavily — saves R98/R100 runs. Shinobi Tactics stacks at 0-3-0.

routes.name: Sticky Bomb
routes.note: Big single-target bomb on MOAB-class; pairs with Flash Bomb stun at 0-0-3.

name: Alchemist
summary: Berserker Brew/Stronger Stimulant buffs damage, pierce, range and speed — the best multiplier in the game.

routes.name: Stronger Stimulant + Perishing Potions
routes.note: Middle crosspath adds acid damage (bonus vs. MOAB-class) to the Alch’s own throws — good when the Alch also has to contribute DPS.

routes.name: Stronger Stimulant + Faster Throwing
routes.note: Throws faster → re-brews more towers and keeps uptime high across a wide cluster. Preferred when buffing many towers.

routes.name: Permanent Brew
routes.note: Brews never expire. Expensive; mostly boss / late freeplay.

name: Druid
summary: Poplust druids buff each other; Heart of Oak blocks regrow.

routes.name: Poplust
routes.note: Stacking buff between druids; Heart of Oak (x-2-x) blocks regrow for R76.

routes.name: Jungle's Bounty
routes.note: Cash + lives ability — disabled value in CHIMPS (income), great in boss events.

name: Mermonkey
summary: Amphibious magic tower (v44). Top line buffs nearby pierce; tier 5s include Lord of the Abyss, Arctic Knight and Poseidon.

routes.name: Top line (→ Lord of the Abyss)
routes.note: Sea-creature attacks, slows bloons and adds pierce to nearby towers — strong value with water/land placement.

routes.name: Bottom line (→ Poseidon)
routes.note: Higher burst/ability focus; better for boss damage windows. Verify current crosspath numbers in-game.

name: Skywarden
summary: New in v56 (Aug 2026). Wind-magic archer: path 1 boosts range (and nearby range) up to Farwind Seer; path 2 explosive arcs; path 3 shatter.

routes.name: Farwind Seer (Path 1)
routes.note: Range-scaling arrows that hit harder the farther they fly; Zephyr Sense (x-2) gives camo. Crosspath consensus still forming.

routes.name: Thunder's Decree (Path 2)
routes.note: Thundering Arc explosions grow with distance and can target a location over walls.

name: Banana Farm
summary: Disabled in CHIMPS. In boss events BRFs + Banana Central are the land economy backbone.

routes.name: Banana Research Facility
routes.note: 5 crates × $390 = $1,950/round with Valuable Bananas; +25% with Banana Central.

routes.name: Marketplace
routes.note: Auto-collects 16 cash packets/round; boosted sellback → cheap, flexible stepping stone.

routes.name: Monkey Bank
routes.note: Stores cash with interest; collect manually. Upgrades to IMF Loan (x-4-x) for loan cycles.

name: Spike Factory
summary: End-of-track insurance; Perma-Spike is an elite leak-stopper.

routes.name: Perma-Spike
routes.note: Fast production of very durable, high-damage spikes — consistent leak protection every round.

routes.name: Carpet of Spikes (incl. Spike Storm)
routes.note: Spike Storm ability (x-4-x) for a single burst; Carpet adds periodic map-wide spikes. Better for planned rush rounds.

routes.name: Super Mines
routes.note: Huge explosive mines; black bloons immune — pair with other damage types.

name: Monkey Village
summary: Radar (camo) + MIB (all damage types) solve most property problems in one tower.

routes.name: Monkey Intelligence Bureau
routes.note: Lets towers in radius pop any bloon type (lead/black/purple/frozen) + Jungle Drums speed.

routes.name: Call to Arms
routes.note: Periodic +50% speed/pierce ability — line it up with R98/R100.

routes.name: Monkey City
routes.note: Eco village (no CHIMPS value). Monkeyopolis (x-x-5) absorbs farms for big crates.

name: Engineer Monkey
summary: Overclock supercharges a carry or a BRF; Ultraboost makes it permanent.

routes.name: Overclock
routes.note: Huge temporary attack-speed buff (or production for farms). Rotate onto your carry.

routes.name: Ultraboost
routes.note: Permanent stacking boost to one tower — late-game scaling.

routes.name: Bloon Trap
routes.note: Captures bloons for cash (income disabled in CHIMPS) — boss-event utility.

name: Beast Handler
summary: Fish/dino/bird lines (Megalodon, Giganotosaurus, Pouākai). Handlers can merge beasts to reach higher power.

routes.name: Dino line (→ Giganotosaurus)
routes.note: Strong ground DPS + roar stun; merging handlers accelerates power.

routes.name: Water line (→ Megalodon)
routes.note: Water-only; grabs and drowns bloons/MOABs — great on water maps.

routes.name: Bird line (→ Pouākai)
routes.note: Flying birds with map coverage; strong vs. scattered spawns.
